grind coffee beans.name: retrieve cup and scale
grind coffee beans.definition: Grab espresso cup from rack, place it on scale, and position scale on the counter.

grind coffee beans.name: record ingredients on phone
grind coffee beans.definition: Open phone, check app, and write down coffee ingredients.

grind coffee beans.name: prepare coffee beans
grind coffee beans.definition: Take coffee can, open it, pour beans into the cup, and close the can.

grind coffee beans.name: grind coffee beans
grind coffee beans.definition: Bring grinder forward, open cap, pour in beans, tap machine, and grind the coffee.

grind coffee beans.name: transfer grounds
grind coffee beans.definition: Scoop and mix the ground coffee from the grinder into the espresso cup.

tamp coffee grounds.name: settle coffee grounds
tamp coffee grounds.definition: Tap the espresso cup to loosen the beans and place the scoop back on the machine.

tamp coffee grounds.name: press coffee grounds
tamp coffee grounds.definition: Use the press to pack down the coffee beans in the espresso cup.

tamp coffee grounds.name: position cup in machine
tamp coffee grounds.definition: Put the presser away and place the espresso cup within the machine.

pull espresso shot.name: secure espresso cup
pull espresso shot.definition: Tighten and clip the espresso cup into the espresso machine while steadying the unit.

pull espresso shot.name: start extraction
pull espresso shot.definition: Move phone out of the way, turn on the coffee machine, and wait while the coffee drips.

pull espresso shot.name: serve espresso
pull espresso shot.definition: Stop and turn off the machine, retrieve a small plate from the drawer, and remove the cup.
